acyclic_support_construction: Separate native receipt precheck from committed support consumption: verify current actual receipt/authentication and privately admitted exact result, evaluate original native receipt clauses without requiring a support instance, derive expected ReceiptObservation and candidate SupportRecord, then run guarded native transition on those private candidates. Actual observation must exactly match candidate and complete native obligations must pass. No support record is assumed to prove itself; initial acceptance comes from independent native receipt clauses after independently admitted validation.
alternate_event_paths: For V01 registered gates, plain ExternalEvent EVIDENCE_VALIDATED cannot publish validation/support or bypass the wrapper. append/apply event dispatch rejects it as VALIDATION_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED. The wrapper uses native receipt transition primitive internally only after verified private candidate construction. Legacy unregistered gate event behavior remains unchanged.

atomicity.execution: No reachable HEAD with partial result/support/Evidence/observation/event. No result without event; no accepted validation without complete support; no support without admitted result; no head change without complete bundle.
atomicity.installation: All three definitions/physical pins/installed witness/use consumption/event commit together; independent from lifecycle commit
atomicity.publication: Reuse I01/I02 local single-writer CAS/staging/fsync/atomic HEAD protocol; no distributed atomicity claimed. Unreachable orphan files are not admitted. Before HEAD failure leaves old state/use; after HEAD restore exactly once.

canonical_ownership.A10: EVIDENCE_VALIDATED, accepted ReceiptObservation and external_complete; no reentry
canonical_ownership.A11: DEPENDENT_ACTION_REENTRY and C03 named eligibility; canonical matrix does not assign a new typed proof admission to A11

command_fields.provenance: current pinned execution input provenance, native/source ancestry and installed contract bindings
command_fields.receipt_reference: canonical admission body ContentID + artifact + actual ingress_event_id + actual received_event_id
command_fields.semantic_binding: historically admitted E01 binding/E07 operand witness, never unchecked caller replacement

command_identity: SHA256(codec.canonical_bytes(closed command excluding own key)); includes all identity domains/parents/policy/provenance. No nonce/time/UUID; outcome is deterministic output, not caller command field.
control: Always core.recompute(projected post-state), never require pre==post. Positive received->validated still leaves external boundary pending named reentry; P04 exact-model oracle EXTERNAL_WAIT with no selected/actionable/human-ready Action. Generic model may derive another existing control; contract oracle/frame must prove it.

currentness_and_invalidation.affected_graph: Evidence/receipt/producer/authenticator/validator rule/definition and expected-source pins -> matching validation results -> matching support -> Evidence obligation and affected named Actions; bounded IDs only
currentness_and_invalidation.authentication_consumer: Keep installed operating ATTEST and ingress bindings consumer=A09. A10 consumes their historically admitted Evidence/receipt witness and current source competence; it does not retarget, reissue or broaden ATTEST permission to consumer=A10.
currentness_and_invalidation.consumer_guard: For a registered V01 gate/requirement, _check_receipt and obligation_proof must additionally resolve the exact current result/support/member/activation/receipt binding before their ordinary native checks. Private transaction uses only its own complete proposed records. Legacy unregistered fixtures retain existing semantics. No global proposition-equality shortcut, unrelated dossier validation, Evidence validated flag alone or mutable CURRENT flag establishes V01 support.
currentness_and_invalidation.definition_currentness: Installation-time and pre-execution contract currentness requires only current installed set/member bodies, declared gate/requirement/template references, rule registration, canonical source pins, operating source-authentication definitions and context/validity. Actual received Evidence, ValidationResult and support instance are NOT prerequisites for installing or making definitions current. Those are execution/instance applicability checks.
currentness_and_invalidation.execution_authority: No new operating class granted by validation. Installed validated rule plus current admitted source authentication bounds pure validation; INSTALL permission itself is not ATTEST, proof or Action permission.
currentness_and_invalidation.generation_scope_lineage: Mismatch fails consumption; never transfer records or switch context as a side effect. New generation/replacement is separately governed.
currentness_and_invalidation.positive_usable: Historical PASS + current result inputs and exact installed definitions + current receipt/Evidence/source/rule/authority/context; then current exact support observation. Old arbitrary proposition-equal ValidationInstance cannot supply this registered contract.
currentness_and_invalidation.receipt: No delete/mutate operation invented; loss of current admission, ingress ancestry/authentication/source withdraws its support. Any future independent receipt-revocation requires own native event contract.
currentness_and_invalidation.withdrawal: Retain immutable result/outcome/event. Derive STALE/unusable records and E04-compatible STALE ValidationInstance/Evidence projection under existing SourceInvalidation/explicit definition withdrawal. Support no longer satisfies obligation; no automatic reentry or proof generation.

event_operand_type: ValidationSupportAdmission (future ExecutionEvent union member; no loose Snapshot or helper ValidationResult as event)
execution_order: CAS-load externally trusted current bundle/head and pure model validation
resolve installed atomic definition set and actual received Evidence/admission/ingress ancestry; no Evidence materialization
evaluate current operating authentication and definition/source/rule applicability
independently run registered validator in private memory -> typed ValidationAssessment (validation execution)
verify all binding/result identity/witness clauses -> construct ValidationResultRecord (still transient)
privately admit ValidationResult and exact native ValidationInstance projection and Evidence qualification

only after private result admission, independently precheck native receipt clauses (not V01 support consumption), derive exact expected observation and candidate support record, and stage that candidate privately
run ordinary received->EVIDENCE_VALIDATED transition once with complete private result/support candidates; compare actual observation to expected candidate and complete obligation checks
verify contract postcondition/frame and complete native recompute (no proof admission or reentry)
create one ordinary ValidationSupportAdmission ExecutionEvent over complete post-state
stage immutable complete bundle/event/result/source references under single-writer lock; atomic HEAD publication
hash_cycle_rule: Result/support records include command key, pre-state, parent and sequence; not their containing event or post-state hash. Post-state first -> event ID -> ledger/root -> bundle ID; result activation verified by join to one ordinary event. Definition/member/set descriptors exclude own IDs and self-provenance.

idempotence.different_result: Same Evidence/receipt/contract/generation may have only one accepted historical decision. Different outcome fails VALIDATION_CONFLICT; separately authorized new contract version/received Evidence is needed, no overwrite.
idempotence.execution: Before stale-parent check, recognize exact previously committed command-key/full-payload equality in trusted lineage; return original immutable result/support/event references without new event/decision and report present usability. Same key/different input or assessment body rejects; new-key repeated same receipt/contract/result context is semantic no-op only after current authority/source/head checks, never rerun to create duplicates.
idempotence.installation: I02 exact request-key/full-payload retry returns prior result; same identity/different bytes CONFLICT, no duplicate event or grant use; cannot reactivate stale set

installed_projection.currentness: Exact active set/member/role/installation witness + current INSTALL permission + canonical body/source equality + rule registration/source bindings + current operating authentication + exact context/generation/consumer/tick. Native installed-record/event temporal join, not caller CURRENT flag.
installed_projection.event: Existing INSTALL_DEFINITION; existing bounded authority semantics unchanged
installed_projection.frame: Definition registries/membership/authorized immutable source additions/INSTALL audit/one event only; no ValidationInstance, ValidationResult, support instance, Evidence, receipt, proof, ActionResult, status change or operating authority issuance
installed_projection.order: Validate member DAG validation -> support -> transaction before publication; commit all three in one existing INSTALL_DEFINITION event. Members not independently installable; missing/mismatched ref/conflict aborts.
installed_projection.replacement: INSTALL only if aggregate role and all member roles absent. Occupied different identity CONFLICT; explicit exact REPLACE predecessor/set grant required for future replacement. No partial member overwrite or automatic predecessor fallback.
installed_projection.snapshot_fields: Future optional immutable tuples validation_contracts, validation_support_contracts, validation_transaction_contracts; default empty/omitted for old snapshots. validation_results and validation_support_records tuples separately added only by execution; native instances/observations are their exact projections.
installed_projection.unsupported_current_runtime: Requires closed typed adapter, model/codec/event consumer support; not implemented by V01

native_support_checks: After private PASS admission, gates.check_receipt and gates.external_complete must pass independently before positive publish; PASS assessment alone does not create support. Failure is atomic abort. Native ProofState.PROVED is derived, never a persisted ProofResult or generic TRUE proof.

output_records.ValidationInstance_projection: E04-compatible proposition/contract ContentID in legacy dossier field/input identities/outcome/context/provenance; never claim a DecisionDossier was created. Generated scoped predicate cannot independently replace Evidence-obligation proof.

ValidationResultRecord.compatibility: Retain E04 ValidationResult projection (identity/evidence/predicate/outcome/scope/lineage) if exposed by API; persisted v1 record adds required ancestry/contract/support bindings. Never retrofit identities in E04 history.
ValidationResultRecord.id: CONTENT_IDENTITY/planner-validation-result-record-v1; canonical closed body excluding own id and activation event ID; historical outcome immutable

ValidationSupportRecord.id: CONTENT_IDENTITY/planner-validation-support-record-v1 over complete canonical body minus own ID/event ID
ValidationSupportRecord.outcome: ACCEPTED_RECEIPT_SUPPORT or REJECTED_RECEIPT_OBSERVATION; rejection is audit, not usable support
ValidationSupportRecord.projection: One existing native ReceiptObservation; claims exact admitted claims only on acceptance, empty on rejection; no overwrite/erasure of prior history

output_records.expiry: valid_until = minimum declared contract, source, receipt authentication, Evidence and validator applicability boundary; current tick must be within every bound, never refresh during retry/replay
output_records.field_types: IDs/references are exact native ArtifactIdentity/Identifier types with declared domains; sequence is positive integer; outcome enum PASS|FAIL or support enum; scope/lineage/generation nonempty strings equal context; input identities unique native-declared unordered tuple; reasons unique sorted strings; provenance native Provenance with full declared input bindings. Reject omitted/extra fields and types.
output_records.post_bundle: ordinary native PersistenceBundle; new event/state/root/head all codec-derived, no parallel snapshot export
output_records.predicate_projection: New scoped PredicateId VALIDATION:<hash(validation_contract,evidence,scope,lineage,generation)> for native ValidationInstance only at admission; never E2-PROOF or any existing requirement/authority predicate. Existing EVIDENCE_OBLIGATION stays unchanged.
output_records.receipt_reference: CONTENT_IDENTITY/planner-receipt-admission-reference-v1 over complete canonical ReceiptAdmission plus actual ingress/received event references; derived only after A09 exists

persistence_replay.codec: Versioned closed new types/optional default-empty state fields and ExecutionEvent union extension; preserve pre-V01 canonical bytes and identities when fields absent
persistence_replay.fresh_readers: Seeds 0,1,7,101; >=3 terminated-writer fresh cold reads per checkpoint/seed; trust expected bundle externally; compare full computation/branch witnesses/native identities/pins/event ordering and declared unordered sets; patch semantic validator forbidden during replay
preserve: current applicability and immutable historical outcomes
persistence_replay.replay: At installation event enable definitions; at validation event decode committed typed witness/result/support, verify structural binding/identity/accepted historical provenance and deterministic post-state, and project historical decision. Do not invoke live semantic validator, new oracle, user authorization or new assessment/result identity. Verify stored clause-witness consistency and native receipt query, not fresh validation decision.
persistence_replay.source_chronology: Before install/event unavailable; after correct prefix present. Each prefix uses its own sources/currentness/tick; future source invalidation does not erase historical acceptance.

precommit_identity: CONTENT_IDENTITY/planner-validation-support-precommit-v1 over exact command key, assessment/result/support bodies and expected post-state digest. Single-writer CAS detects changes after preflight.
private_context: Only the closed transaction coordinator creates internal PreparedValidationCommit context after full command/assessment/result validation; it binds pre-bundle/state/head/sequence and complete result/support candidates. It is not a serialized authentication/currentness boolean or an untrusted caller operand. Event activation is pending only inside unreachable working state; final codec replay verifies exact one event/record join. No intermediate working Snapshot can be saved/restored as a canonical checkpoint.
projection_frame: Change only exact Evidence qualification, result/support registries and native ValidationInstance/ReceiptObservation projections, target gate stage/history, ordinary event/root/head and necessary exact source refs. Preserve Actions/statuses/completion, actual knowledge, root/slot state, typed_proofs, decisions/reentry, context/policy and unrelated gates. No EVIDENCE_RECEIVED repetition; no rule_known setter.
proof_boundary: ReceiptObservation is typed accepted Evidence support. Native obligation_proof may derive PROVED. No persisted ProofResult, EvidenceProof, SLOT_PROOF or ROOT_PROOF is generated by A10. A11_PROOF_ABSENT denotes an instance, not prohibition of computed ProofState.PROVED.
qualification_required: Specification only. Future implementation must pass positive accepted/rejected generic fixtures, alpha renaming and changed values, authority separation, atomic failure injections, duplicate/conflicting retry, source withdrawal and historical replay/fresh readers before live use.

rejected_postcondition.gate_stage: WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE via existing core.apply_receipt rejection; pending/history retained according to native transition

CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.FAIL_domain: Well-formed authorized received input under a contract allowing the input; semantic clause false. Generic rejected fixture must declare independent binding/source and expected clauses before execution; arbitrary wrong pins do not qualify as a legitimate FAIL.
CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.assessment_identity: CONTENT_IDENTITY/planner-validation-assessment-v1 over canonical command_key, full typed input_bindings, contract/rule identities, ordered clause witnesses, outcome, context and provenance, excluding own ID; no event or post-state identity
CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.assessment_type: ValidationAssessment: input_bindings, contract/rule identities, ordered checks (clause_id, typed expected/actual values, result/reasons), outcome PASS|FAIL, scope/lineage/generation, provenance, deterministic identity; not a persisted instance
CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.clause_values: Closed tagged values: ArtifactIdentity, typed native Identifier, JSON scalar/object validated by the pinned semantic schema, or finite ordered/set reference inventory. Boolean outcome or arbitrary caller evaluator is not a ValidationAssessment.
CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.implementation: Future qualified closed deterministic validator; consume canonical receipt/authentication and independently sealed semantic expectations, never caller PASS
CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.independence: Source competence from current I04 operating authentication plus trusted actual A09 receipt; expectation/rule origin from V01 body admitted under independent INSTALL decision. Hash equality alone is not competence or validation.
semantic_checks: parse pinned semantic payload using registered closed schema
validate semantic ID/content domains using pinned mapping profile
compare proposition, subject, producer, gate, requirement and context to installed contract expectations
compare every declared semantic expectation to pinned source facts
return ordered typed clause witnesses with PASS iff all clauses hold; FAIL iff a declared semantic clause is false
CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.semantic_schema: Registered canonical-source payload schema with required fields schema, qualification_only, scope, lineage, generation, currentness, gate_id, proposition_id, proposition, source_id, subject and value; required values and typed identity domains from independently installed semantic_expectations. No unknown fields; minimum v1 generic adapter copies no E2 literals into code.
structural_checks: installed active atomic set and exact member bodies
one actual produced received unvalidated Evidence
unique canonical ReceiptAdmission and its exact ingress/received events
E07 committed typed attestation witness and E01 semantic/native mapping
CANONICAL_AUTHENTICATED_EVIDENCE_VALIDAT.unsupported_or_untrusted_input: Abort with reason; not a FAIL result and no committed event

structural_schema: Each member body contains schema and contract only; every contract field is exactly the field set of its sealed body. Generic operands below use closed typed fields, reject unknown/missing/duplicate fields, arbitrary executable rules and booleans in place of assessments.
support_failure_on_PASS: Abort entire transaction with SUPPORT_POSTCONDITION_MISMATCH; publish no accepted validation without required support. Unrelated existing support cannot satisfy result/evidence/receipt-specific witness.
